# Aarvak Diagnostics

> Trusted pathology, radiology and health checkup lab in Gurugram offering NABL-standard testing and home sample collection.

Aarvak Diagnostics is a Gurugram-based diagnostic centre providing pathology, radiology, preventive health checkups, corporate camps, and home sample collection across Gurugram and nearby sectors.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Aarvak Diagnostics services in Gurugram.
- [About Us](/about-us): Mission, leadership team, and clinical approach.
- [Contact Us](/contact-us): Booking, phone, address, and enquiry form.
- [Corporate Health Camps](/corporate): On-site corporate wellness and check-up camps.

## Departments

- [Pathology Lab](/departments/pathology): Blood, urine, and clinical pathology testing.
- [Radiology Centre](/departments/radiology): Digital imaging, X-Ray and PFT services.
- [X-Ray Services](/departments/radiology/x-ray-services): Digital X-ray for bones, chest and injury evaluation.
- [PFT Test](/departments/radiology/pft-test): Pulmonary Function Testing for lung health.
- [Health Checkups](/departments/health-checkups): Preventive full body checkup packages.
- [Biochemistry Tests](/departments/pathology/biochemistry-tests): LFT, KFT, lipid, sugar, thyroid.
- [Hematology Tests](/departments/pathology/hematology-tests): CBC, ESR, coagulation, peripheral smear.
- [Microbiology](/departments/pathology/Microbiology): Cultures, sensitivity, infection panels.
- [Histopathology](/departments/pathology/histopathology-tests): Tissue biopsy and cytology.
- [Immunology Tests](/departments/pathology/immunology-tests): Allergy, autoimmune, hormone panels.
- [Molecular Diagnostics](/departments/pathology/molecular-diagnostics): PCR and DNA-based testing.
